title: Reading Practice Test 02 – Travel & Hospitality
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: chuỗi tin nhắn, câu hỏi NOT, chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: du lịch, khách sạn, chính sách công tác.

questions.content: The hotel's shuttle bus runs ------- between the airport and the city center every thirty minutes.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'runs' cần trạng từ → 'regularly'.

questions.content: Guests who wish to check out after noon should inform the front desk ------- 9:00 A.M.
questions.explanation: Hành động báo trước một lần với hạn chót → 'by 9:00 A.M.' (chậm nhất lúc 9 giờ). 'until' dùng cho hành động kéo dài.

questions.content: The tour guide ------- the group through the old town when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra thì hành động khác xen vào (when it started) → quá khứ tiếp diễn 'was leading'.

questions.content: The Sunset Resort is ------- located just five minutes from the beach.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ 'located' → 'conveniently located' (nằm ở vị trí thuận tiện).

questions.content: ------- the heavy snow, all flights to Denver were canceled yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ 'the heavy snow' → giới từ 'Due to' (do, bởi). 'Because' cần mệnh đề; 'In spite' thiếu 'of'.

questions.content: Passengers must keep their seat belts ------- while the plane is moving on the runway.
questions.explanation: keep + O + tính từ/V3 (trạng thái bị động): giữ dây an toàn được thắt → 'fastened'.

questions.content: The travel agency offers a wide ------- of vacation packages for families.
questions.explanation: Cụm 'a wide variety of' = nhiều loại. Sau mạo từ + tính từ cần danh từ → 'variety'.

questions.content: If the train ------- on time, we would have arrived before the meeting started.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3 (would have arrived) → mệnh đề If dùng quá khứ hoàn thành 'had left'.

questions.content: Room rates at the Parkview Inn ------- breakfast and free Wi-Fi.
questions.explanation: Giá phòng 'bao gồm' dịch vụ → 'include'. 'consist' phải đi với 'of'; 'contain' dùng cho vật chứa bên trong.

questions.content: Ms. Kim, ------- flight was delayed by three hours, will join the conference by video.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ 'flight' và thể hiện sở hữu (chuyến bay của cô Kim) → 'whose'.

groups.passage:
Dear Mr. Patel,

Thank you for choosing the Bayview Hotel for your upcoming stay. We are pleased to ---131--- your reservation for a deluxe ocean-view room from July 14 to July 17.

As a Bayview Rewards member, you are entitled to a complimentary breakfast each morning in our Seaside Restaurant. ---132---, you may check in as early as noon at no extra charge.

Please note that our outdoor pool ---133--- for maintenance from July 15 to July 16. ---134---. We apologize for any inconvenience.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Sincerely,
Lena Ortiz
Guest Services Manager

questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'be pleased to + V nguyên mẫu' → 'confirm'.
Câu sau bổ sung thêm một quyền lợi nữa (nhận phòng sớm) cho hội viên → 'In addition'.
Hồ bơi 'bị đóng' (bị động) trong khoảng thời gian tương lai 15–16/7 → 'will be closed'.

options.A: Guests may use the indoor pool on the second floor during that time.
options.D: Please return your room key at checkout.

questions.explanation: Sau thông báo hồ bơi ngoài trời đóng cửa, câu hợp lý là đưa ra phương án thay thế: dùng hồ bơi trong nhà.

groups.passage:
Tom Reyes (2:05 P.M.)
Hi Julia, I just landed in Lisbon, but my suitcase didn't arrive. The airline says it'll be delivered to the hotel tonight.

Julia Park (2:07 P.M.)
Oh no! Do you have what you need for tomorrow's presentation?

Tom Reyes (2:08 P.M.)
The slides are on my laptop, which I carried on. But my suit is in the suitcase.

Julia Park (2:10 P.M.)
There's a department store next to the hotel.

Tom Reyes (2:11 P.M.)
Good idea. I'll stop by after I check in.

questions.content: What problem does Mr. Reyes mention?

options.D: His hotel room is not ready.

questions.explanation: 'My suitcase didn't arrive… it'll be delivered to the hotel tonight' → hành lý đến trễ.

questions.content: At 2:10 P.M., what does Ms. Park most likely mean when she writes, "There's a department store next to the hotel"?

options.A: The hotel is easy to find.
options.B: She would like to go shopping with him.
options.C: Mr. Reyes could buy clothes there.

questions.explanation: Bộ vest nằm trong vali chưa tới → cô gợi ý mua quần áo ở cửa hàng bách hoá gần khách sạn; anh đáp 'Good idea'.

groups.passage:
Coastal Rail Tours – Scenic Day Trip

Enjoy a relaxing ride along the Pacific coast aboard our restored 1950s train. The trip departs from Harbor Station at 9:00 A.M. and returns at 5:30 P.M.

Highlights include:
• A two-hour stop in the fishing village of Morro Point
• Lunch at the Cliffside Café (included in the ticket price)
• Live commentary from a local historian

Tickets: $120 for adults, $60 for children under 12. Seats in our glass-roof panorama car are available for an additional $25.

Tours run on Saturdays and Sundays from April to October. Book at least 48 hours in advance on our Web site. Group discounts are available for parties of ten or more.

questions.content: What is included in the ticket price?

options.A: A seat in the panorama car

questions.explanation: 'Lunch at the Cliffside Café (included in the ticket price)'. Ghế toa panorama phải trả thêm $25.

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned about the tour?

options.B: It includes commentary from an expert.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: tour chỉ chạy thứ Bảy và Chủ nhật, không có ngày thường. (A), (B), (D) đều được nhắc tới.

questions.content: How can customers receive a discount?

options.D: By traveling with a large group

questions.explanation: 'Group discounts are available for parties of ten or more.'

groups.passage:
★★★★☆ A Great Base for Exploring the City
Reviewed by Carla M., Toronto

I stayed at the Grand Meridian Hotel for four nights last month while attending a conference. The location could not be better: the hotel is a short walk from the convention center and several excellent restaurants. [1]

My room was spacious and very clean, and the bed was extremely comfortable. [2] The only drawback was the noise from the street on Friday night, when a festival was taking place nearby. When I mentioned this to the front desk, the staff immediately moved me to a quieter room on a higher floor. [3]

The breakfast buffet had a wide selection, although it became crowded after 8:00 A.M. [4] I would definitely stay here again on my next trip.

questions.content: Why did Carla M. stay at the hotel?

options.C: She was performing at a festival.
options.D: She was attending a professional event.

questions.explanation: '…while attending a conference' – hội nghị là sự kiện chuyên môn.

questions.content: What problem did Carla M. experience?

options.A: Her room was noisy one night.
options.B: Her room had not been cleaned.

questions.explanation: 'The only drawback was the noise from the street on Friday night.'

questions.content: What does Carla M. suggest about the breakfast?

options.B: Guests should go before 8:00 A.M. to avoid crowds.
options.C: It is not included in the room rate.

questions.explanation: 'It became crowded after 8:00 A.M.' → ngụ ý nên đi ăn trước 8 giờ. (A) sai vì 'had a wide selection'.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"I was impressed by how quickly they solved the problem."
questions.explanation: 'the problem' chỉ tiếng ồn, và 'they' là nhân viên lễ tân vừa đổi phòng cho cô → đặt ở [3].

groups.passage:
MEMO – Travel Policy Update (effective May 1)

• Employees traveling for business must book flights through the company's travel portal.
• Economy class is required for flights under six hours. Business class may be booked for longer flights with a manager's approval.
• Hotel costs may not exceed $180 per night, except in New York and London, where the limit is $250.
• Meal expenses are reimbursed up to $60 per day. Original receipts must be submitted within 14 days of return.

To: Grace Holloway
From: Victor Lam
Date: May 20
Subject: London trip approval

Hi Grace,

I'm preparing my trip to London for the client workshop on June 11. Since the workshop begins at 9:00 A.M., I'd like to take the earliest-arriving flight so that I have time to check in to my hotel and prepare. I plan to fly economy to keep costs down.

I've found a hotel near the client's office for $235 per night. Could you please approve these arrangements so that I can book them through the travel portal?

Thanks,
Victor

questions.content: According to the memo, when may employees book business class?

options.B: For long flights with a manager's approval
options.D: When economy seats are sold out

questions.explanation: 'Business class may be booked for longer flights (trên 6 tiếng) with a manager's approval.'

questions.content: Which flight will Mr. Lam most likely take?
questions.explanation: Anh muốn chuyến hạ cánh sớm nhất và bay hạng phổ thông → UA 930 đến lúc 7:20 sáng (kết hợp e-mail và bảng chuyến bay).

questions.content: What is indicated about the hotel Mr. Lam found?

options.A: It is located near the airport.
options.C: Its rate complies with company policy.
options.D: It must be booked directly with the hotel.

questions.explanation: Khách sạn $235/đêm ở London; memo cho phép tối đa $250 ở London → phù hợp chính sách.

questions.content: In the e-mail, the phrase "keep costs down" in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: keep costs down = giữ chi phí ở mức thấp → limit spending.

questions.content: What must Mr. Lam do after returning from London?

options.A: Submit his receipts within a set period
options.B: Write a report for his manager
options.D: Book his next trip through the portal

questions.explanation: Theo memo: 'Original receipts must be submitted within 14 days of return.'
